package.name: san_rtk_gnss
package.description:
SAN v1.5 Phase 2-E Turn 4 — RTK GNSS driver (Tier 1 C++).
u-blox F9P over serial: parses NMEA $GxGGA, publishes NavSatFix + RtkFixStatus + gga_latest. Accepts RTCM corrections via topic and injects them back to the receiver over the same serial port (thread-safe via SerialInterface).
Replaces adapters/rtk_gnss.py per DCN-2026-002 D-007/D-008.
